//: Type-checks the browser JavaScript from its JSDoc (npm run check:js). Nothing
is emitted: the sources are served as they are. Node's types are left out on
purpose so browser code cannot lean on Node globals (setTimeout returning a
Timeout, Buffer, process); scripts/tsconfig.json adds them for the tooling,
Target ES2022: the app needs Web Serial, WebUSB or Web Bluetooth, so it runs on
Chromium (Web Serial since 89), and every Chromium that can clone also has JSPI
(137+). strictNullChecks is on (2026-10-09; it found 203 errors here and 52
in scripts/): a value that can be null is typed T|null and checked, and a
null-initialised variable says what it will hold. strict itself stays off
until noImplicitAny (~1700 annotations) and useUnknownInCatchVariables are
paid for. Every other strict-family flag that costs nothing is on.
